selection_policy: The next 18 consecutive official records after the original 1-12 selection; no aesthetic cherry-picking.
transformation_policy: Preserve the original subject, important visible objects, scene relationships, and product/game identity while narrowing the deliverable to one 1280x800 single-page rendered view. Functional requirements that cannot be judged from one image are represented as visible UI/state cues. The original hidden checklists were not copied into generation prompts.
